decisions.reason: Despite two years without clear website visibility, this resin injection unit remains in a core technology area, so existing engineering and service slack still supports keeping it while management looks for firmer evidence.
Because it overlaps with another resin injection unit and has shown no visible follow-through, management is likely to judge it below aspiration in internal comparison and reallocate the resources.
The manual airless spray gun fits the firm's established spray-equipment routines and distributor channels, which makes retention more likely even if its recent signals are muted.
As a product line with several models in a central spray category, it offers enough strategic relevance, adaptation potential and channel fit for management to continue it.

The data logger is less central than the firm's mechanical equipment lines, and prolonged weak visibility would more readily trigger problemistic search and a shift of resources to core products or new development.
